news.title: “Carpet” growth method yields long-sought 2D quantum material
news.summary_en: A new approach to growing a thin sheet of bismuth telluride let UChicago PME researchers confirm its ability to form a 2D topological insulator at ambient conditions.

news.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum
news.summary_en: Two new awards will expand Fermilab’s critical role in the Genesis Mission by developing custom microelectronics and advancing quantum information science.

news.title: New DOE Early Career project uses magnetic vortices to uncover hidden sources of loss in superconducting quantum devices
news.summary_en: Fermilab's Daniel Bafia will develop a new measurement approach that uses magnetic vortices to investigate defects and interfaces that can limit the performance of superconducting quantum devices.

news.title: Fermilab physicist wins DOE Early Career Award to study dark matter with entangled qubits
news.summary_en: Building on her earlier work with quantum amplifiers for a leading dark matter experiment, Rakshya Khatiwada will use a four-qubit entangled system to test whether it offers a sensing advantage when exposed to a simulated dark matter signal.
